description: Automate content creation, SEO optimization, email outreach, and influencer partnerships with BurstyAI's no-code AI workflows.

runWorkflow.name: runWorkflow
runWorkflow.description: Run a Bursty AI workflow and optionally wait for and return the results

workflow_id.description: The ID of the Bursty AI workflow to run

get_result.description: Wait for the workflow to complete and return the results (default: false)

aiMetadata.description: Starts (triggers) a BurstyAI no-code AI workflow by its workflow ID, launching a new asynchronous execution. Use to kick off a BurstyAI content/SEO/outreach automation; enable "Wait for Result" to block and poll until the job completes (returns the result, times out after ~10 minutes), or leave it off to fire-and-return the job handle immediately. Not idempotent: each call starts a separate workflow run.
